topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Hi there, I appreciate the honesty in your request. Our yard has been so unused, and I can see the appeal in transforming a bit of it into something productive and beautiful like a garden. I just want you to know that I've been thinking a lot about our community and how we can support each other. It's just that I've also been a bit overwhelmed with keeping up with my own responsibilities lately, and the idea of overseeing a communal space makes me a little nervous. I hope you understand. Maybe we can revisit this in the future when I feel more settled. Thanks again for considering me and our yard for this project.
